stories.title: Geocode command
stories.description: As a developer, I want to geocode addresses so I can get coordinates for my dataset.
requirements: Implement geocode command with single address input
Return JSON with coordinate, formatted address, timezone
Handle no results with exit code 3
acceptance: applmaps geocode "Apple Park" returns valid JSON

stories.title: Reverse geocode command
stories.description: As a scripter, I want to reverse geocode coordinates so I can display human-readable locations.
requirements: Implement reverse command accepting lat/lon arguments
Return Address object with all fields

stories.title: Search command
stories.description: As an agent, I want to search for nearby places so I can find businesses programmatically.
requirements: Implement search with query and optional near/radius/limit
Return array of Place objects with documented fields

stories.title: ETA command
stories.description: As a scripter, I want to get travel time estimates so I can optimize routes.
requirements: Implement eta command with from/to arguments
Support multiple to destinations

stories.title: Directions command
stories.description: As a developer, I want full route directions so I can display turn-by-turn navigation.
requirements: Implement directions with from/to and transport mode
Return Route array with steps, distance, duration

stories.title: Batch geocode stdin mode
stories.description: As a scripter, I want to batch geocode addresses so I can process large datasets.
requirements: Add stdin mode to geocode
Process one address per line sequentially

stories.title: Open maps command
stories.description: As a user, I want to open Maps at a specific location so I can visualize programmatically.
requirements: Implement open with search/location/directions modes
Construct and dispatch proper maps URLs

stories.title: Pin command
stories.description: As a developer, I want to drop labeled pins so I can mark specific points.
requirements: Implement pin with coordinate and optional label

stories.title: MCP server mode
stories.description: As an AI agent, I want structured tool schemas so I can discover capabilities.
requirements: Implement applmaps mcp mode
Expose commands as typed MCP tools
acceptance: Claude Desktop can call applmaps tools via MCP

stories.title: Fields projection
stories.description: As an agent, I want field projection so I can minimize token usage.
requirements: Implement fields flag for all commands
Support comma-separated field list

stories.title: Shell completions
stories.description: As a scripter, I want shell completions so I can use the tool efficiently.
requirements: Generate zsh/bash/fish completions
acceptance: Tab completion works for commands and flags

stories.title: JSON schema export
stories.description: As a developer, I want JSON schema export so I can validate outputs.
requirements: Implement json-schema export flag
Export input/output schema per command
acceptance: Agents can ingest schema for self-documentation

stories.title: Search autocomplete
stories.description: As a developer, I want search autocomplete so I can build type-ahead UIs.
requirements: Implement complete command for search query completion

stories.title: Categories command
stories.description: As a user, I want to list POI categories so I know available filters.
requirements: Implement categories command returning MKPointOfInterestCategory values

stories.title: Server backend option
stories.description: As an enterprise user, I want to use the REST API backend for higher quotas.
requirements: Implement backend server option
Support Apple Maps Server API with API key config
